I still enjoy solving puzzles and working through problems, even now that I'm retired.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes. When I'm faced with a complicated equation or a new concept, my mind starts to race. replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used a simple AI tool last year to help me understand a bit of calculus. It showed me step-by-step how to differentiate equations. Then, use the quadratic formula: x equals negative b plus or minus the square root of b squared minus four a c, all over two a. Plug in the values, calculate carefully, and you’ll get two solutions. It’s a bit tricky, but it works every time.

replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data to fewer dimensions by identifying directions of maximum variance. You start with the data, center it, and compute the covariance matrix. Then, find the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of that matrix. The eigenvectors become the principal components.
